title: Can climate change cause more disease?

vocabulary.meaning: a disease spread by organisms such as mosquitoes or ticks
examples: Vector-borne disease is an important idea when discussing can climate change cause more disease?.
Learning about vector-borne disease can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: a microorganism, such as a virus or bacterium, that can cause disease
examples: People often have different views about pathogen when discussing can climate change cause more disease?.
Understanding pathogen can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: the process by which a disease passes from one person or organism to another
examples: The topic of can climate change cause more disease? raises useful questions about transmission.
We can discuss how transmission affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: a sudden increase in cases of a disease in a particular place
examples: Outbreak can play an important role in debates about can climate change cause more disease?.
Different countries may deal with outbreak in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: a disease whose spread or severity can be affected by climate conditions
examples: A discussion about can climate change cause more disease? can include the effects of climate-sensitive disease.
Knowing the meaning of climate-sensitive disease makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: the health of a population and the organised efforts to protect it
examples: Public health is useful vocabulary for talking about can climate change cause more disease?.
We can use the idea of public health to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
